title.narrative: Strengthening RODA (Dialogue Network for Roma) Network

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to strengthen organization and institutional capacity of Dialogue Network for Roma (RODA) in terms of internal governance, representativeness, financial sustainability and gender mainstreaming; as well as to strengthen the capacity of RODA to reach public in order to raise awareness and advocate rights Roma inclusion, specially inclusion of Romani women and to establish new strategic collaborations with local authorities in gender mainstreaming of Roma inclusion.
